guidance_leads.claim: Prefer higher effort for some tasks; presenter claims benefit per dollar.
Explicitly verify outputs with real tests rather than self-attestation.
Specify finish conditions for long tasks; completion remains unproven until observed.
Review inherited CLAUDE.md and earlier-model instructions for obsolete constraints.
Presenter claims effort and requested brevity affect cost differently; not verified.
Request conclusions and evidence rather than hidden internal reasoning.
Ownership wording may influence behavior, but never grants ownership or permissions.
Do not mandate unnecessary subagent delegation; capability and permissions govern.
Request progress milestones during long interactive work without implying background execution.
Specify output style and length independently of reasoning effort.

note: Unverified research leads only; not attached to a governed skill, not host evaluation results, not official vendor documentation or instructions for any installed skill.
